title: Shoot to the Middle (variation)
author: Adam Carlson
problems: Row 5 "twos swing; end facing up; individually face out. Meanwhile, ones step up to make a short line across with the twos in the middle": a dancer has to move 1.21 m in one beat, faster than a walk.
choices: The 1s end their swing side by side in the middle of the set facing down, the way they progress.
A swing that ends facing down the hall is drawn ending facing across; the down the hall that follows turns the lines.
